why:
STEP 1 -- what actually gates the release. The transcript cannot go out while the financial hold flag is set (e2), and the flag can be lifted only by the bursar's automated batch: no registrar staff member can clear or override it and no manual override exists, which the registrar put in writing on 4 June when the advisor asked for an expedite (e3). So the whole question reduces to when the batch lifts the flag.
STEP 2 -- when the payment clears. Osei paid the full $1,842 by electronic check, the only channel available (e6), at 2:10 PM on Tuesday 2 June (e8). That is a processor business day and it is before the 5:00 PM cutoff, so the processor's rule applies: cleared at 6:00 PM on the third processor business day FOLLOWING the day of submission (e7). Counting business days after Tuesday 2 June: Wednesday 3 June is the first, Thursday 4 June the second, Friday 5 June the third. The payment is marked cleared at 6:00 PM on Friday 5 June 2026.
STEP 3 -- when the batch can see it. The batch runs at 2:00 AM on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays only (e4). Friday 5 June's run happened at 2:00 AM that day -- sixteen hours BEFORE the payment cleared -- so it could not have picked it up. There is no Saturday run, no Sunday run and no Monday run.
STEP 4 -- the first run that can see it. The next run after clearance is 2:00 AM on Tuesday 9 June 2026. That run posts the cleared payment, brings the balance to zero, and lifts the hold (e5). No other charge intervenes and no other payment is pending (e9).
STEP 5 -- the conclusion. The hold is lifted at 2:00 AM on Tuesday 9 June, which is fourteen hours after the 12:00 noon Monday 8 June deadline. The registrar cannot release before the flag clears (e2, e3), and even after it clears takes up to 4 further working hours (e10). Nothing in the period is disturbed by a closure (e11).
ANSWER: no.
NAIVE WRONG ANSWERS. (a) The obvious one: 'she paid the full balance on 2 June, six days before the deadline, so the transcript is plainly out by Monday noon' -- yes. (b) A more careful but still wrong one: get the Friday 5 June 6:00 PM clearance right, then assume the hold lifts overnight, or over the weekend, or that the registrar can act on a visibly cleared payment first thing Monday -- also yes. Both fail for one specific reason: the batch is the only mechanism that can lift the flag, and its calendar has a three-day hole -- Saturday, Sunday and Monday -- so a Friday-evening clearance cannot reach the student record until Tuesday morning. The failure is caused entirely by the batch calendar, not by the payment being late; the payment was made with six days to spare.
